cognitive_validation.rationale: The robot is given a coherent, immanent, nonsupernatural account: radar sensing, under-scanners, reference silhouettes with acknowledged limits, recorded voice, and novelty service circuits. Its behavior follows systematically from its design as a commercial automaton.

novum_candidates.description: Robie, the first mobile sales robot, an autonomous vending machine that seeks out customers, radars crowds, recognizes people via reference silhouettes, and runs an elaborate pre-programmed sales routine. He is the 'logical conclusion of the development of vending machines' and a demonstration model for mass production across the country.
novum_candidates.estrangement_rationale: The robot's unwavering commercial cheer, offering polly-lops and Poppy Pop to charred survivors and a fire hydrant, estranges the reader by contrasting automated consumerist logic against human catastrophe.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: Robie governs the whole narrative logic: the story is structured around his sales routine before and after the catastrophe, and its central irony and closing image depend entirely on the robot mechanically peddling wares amid human devastation.

novelty.rationale: Robie represents a totalizing extrapolation of vending/automation: a self-propelled sales robot explicitly positioned as a new stage of technology destined to populate 'every street and highway in the country,' altering the commercial and social landscape of the storyworld.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The strike is given a coherent technical rationale: a newly developed radar-foiling paint lets the projectile plunge at over three miles a second undetected, an immanent nonsupernatural account.

novum_candidates.description: A radar-foiling nuclear-style missile strike that detonates over Manhattan, incinerating the crowd and devastating the city in the midst of an ongoing 'Hot Truce.'
novum_candidates.estrangement_rationale: The reader is warned of the descending missile the oblivious crowd cannot see, creating dramatic irony between wonderful ordinary life and imminent annihilation.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The blast is the pivotal event, but it functions as a plot catalyst rather than the governing logic; the narrative's overriding meaning and structure remain centered on Robie's continued mechanical salesmanship, for which the catastrophe is the backdrop.

novelty.rationale: A sudden nuclear attack on a major city is a world-altering catastrophe that transforms the storyworld from bright commercial spectacle to devastation.
